submission.comment: Best strategy found: mean_reversion with lookback=67 days, entry_z=1.875, long/short (not long_only), no volatility targeting. Achieves annualized Sharpe of 1.147 with 32.6% annual return, 28.4% annual volatility, 48% max drawdown, and 13.3% time in market. Tested 188 strategies across all families via sweeps and individual backtests.
